content:
jamie: Kicking off change window for release rwd-infer@2026-03-20T22:00Z. Heads up — SLO dashboard panels show ingestion lag (some panels not updating). Watch latency, 5xx, and token throughput.
jamie: Deploy plan: canary v4.2.0 -> 10% across regions, will roll if stable.
deploy-bot: Rollout started rl-20260320-22: rwd-infer:v4.2.0 -> 10% traffic (global canary).
vikram: seeing p95 token latency +30% in eu-west canary pool, dashboard panels are ~120s stale for that region. tags: region=eu-west nodepool=kvcache-2
elaine: to confirm — is this real traffic spike or metric ingestion lag? The p95 chart shows a data_staleness label.
sre-bot: Alert suppressed: metric_ingest_delay > 90s (metrics-ingest-prod). Note: change-window alert suppression is active for noisy signals.
jamie: Suppression ok, but if metrics are stale we can't reliably judge rollout health. Can someone tail the metrics API and the consumer?
mike: Tailing metrics consumer for eu-west, snippet from logs:
```
[22:03:10] metrics-consumer: recv 0 msgs
[22:03:20] metrics-consumer: reconnecting to kafka-broker-3
[22:03:25] metrics-consumer: ack lag=850ms
[22:03:40] metrics-consumer: pushed batch size=0
```
Looks like consumer reconnects / brief lag.
vikram: KVCACHE nodes in eu-west show GC pauses ~1.2s and occasional OOM-kill retries on one pod. Could explain token-level latency.
elaine: Suggest a partial regional pin: rollback eu-west to v4.1.9 (stable) while we investigate ingestion. That should minimize user impact.
jamie: Agreed. Request: do a regional traffic pin for eu-west only, keep rollout in other regions moving. We want minimal blast radius.
deploy-bot: Applying traffic pin: region=eu-west -> rwd-infer:v4.1.9. Canary v4.2.0 traffic in eu-west -> 0% (other regions unchanged). Operation id: pin-20260320-9
vikram: Pin applied — eu-west canary now 0% v4.2.0. Monitoring p95 and 5xx.
mike: After pin, p95 back down to baseline within ~90s. Dashboard still shows ingestion lag but relative metrics indicate improvement.
elaine: Recommend proceed with rollout in NA and APAC, keep eu-west frozen until postmortem. Update release notes: "v4.2.0: partial regional pin in eu-west due to metrics ingestion lag and GC-induced latency; ongoing investigation."
vikram: Opening incident to track root cause and follow-up: INC-20260320-45 (metrics ingestion lag impacting dashboards).
sre-bot: Incident created INC-20260320-45. Assignees: vikram, mike. Severity: Sev3.
jamie: Thanks team. Change window end is 22:30Z — leaving alert suppression in place for metric_ingest signals. If incident duration > 1h we'll convert to a full postmortem. Closing loop: eu-west pinned, NA/APAC continue controlled roll. :thumbsup:
vikram: I'll attach logs and heap profiles to the incident.
mike: Will follow up with kafka consumer offsets and GC traces.
elaine: Noted — I'll update the release notes and ops ticket.
jamie: Great. If anyone sees 5xx bursts or client-facing SLO regressions, call immediate rollback. For now we keep partial pin and monitor. :eyes:
